continuation_cursor.last_completed_action: Completed the M10-004 architecture gate. Added a benchmark-only systematic erasure-code experiment using two independent real kernel TCP lanes, 20:10 (1.5x) and 20:20 (2.0x), with exact erasure-recovery unit tests. Go CI passed. A 50 ms RTT / 200 x 256 B / window 32 / three-seed real-socket sweep over 0/1/2/3/5/8/10/12/15% retransmission-equivalent carrier holds showed clean-network p99 around 52 ms, but 20:20 already reached about 250.5 ms p99 at 1% impairment and remained around 252 ms through 15%; 20:10 was worse. Delivery stayed 100%, proving the failure is latency/HOL rather than reliability. The warmed three-seed udp2raw 20230206.0 + UDPspeeder 20230206.0 mode0 20:20 reference remained about 71 ms p99 with 100% delivery through 15% forward FEC-shard loss. The earlier 2x/3x proactive replication ceiling also failed to remove high-impairment TCP HOL. Current architecture is therefore rejected. Results are recorded in docs/benchmarks/m10-004-fec-no-go.md; temporary benchmark workflows were removed; ARCHITECTURE.md and ROADMAP.md are marked rejected/halted; deps/oracle-lock.json now records the qualified udp2raw/UDPspeeder reference.
